headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7, while the Baltimore Orioles took the win over the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4. The Toronto Blue Jays also secured a 3-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Ryan O'Hearn of the Pittsburgh Pirates, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left quad strain. The Seattle Mariners have also placed Luke Raley on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, with a left forearm strain.

The New York Yankees made a move on August 1, 2026, acquiring outfielder Luis Cruz from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for right-handed pitcher Camilo Doval. The Cleveland Guardians traded C Bo Naylor and RHP Codi Heuer to the Milwaukee Brewers for CF Blake Perkins and RHP Craig Yoho. The Baltimore Orioles also traded RHP Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins for OF Jhomnardo Reyes.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 7 batters and allowing 4 hits. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game, securing their win. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Orioles in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4, securing a crucial win. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took the win with a final score of 3-1 over the St. Louis Cardinals. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Ryan O'Hearn on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates right fielder Ryan O'Hearn has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left quad strain.

top_news.title: **Yankees Acquire OF Luis Cruz in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees made a move on August 1, 2026, acquiring outfielder Luis Cruz from the Pittsburgh Pirates. In exchange, the Yankees traded right-handed pitcher Camilo Doval to the Pirates.
